verdict.rationale: Qdrant's hybrid-queries docs say it combines dense and sparse vectors for semantic plus exact word matching, and that it fuses results from different queries with `rrf` and `dbsf`. Dense and sparse embeddings are first-class configuration options. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of BM25/IDF-style sparse scoring or plain keyword-search integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid fusion quality.
